userdoc.notice: Pure encoder helpers for the `params` blob and `initCalls` array consumed by         `IB20Factory.createB20`. No precompile dispatch, no storage reads, no auth checks.

params.account: Account that failed the role check.
params.neededRole: Role the account was required to hold.

params.feature: Paused feature that gated the operation.

NonPayable().details: The precompile checks `msg.value != 0` at the top of dispatch before any other      validation. All B-20 token selectors are nonpayable.

params.policyId: Policy ID currently configured in that slot.
params.policyScope: Scope of the slot that denied (e.g. `TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY`).

params.attempted: Resulting supply that would exceed the cap.

MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY().details: Unlike the transfer-side policies, this slot is ALWAYS enforced — including for      factory-originated mints during the creation (bootstrap) window — so new supply is never      issued to a policy-denied recipient even at creation. See `IB20Factory.createB20`.

SEIZE_HOLDER_POLICY().details: A `from` is seizable only when it is NOT authorized by this policy. An unset slot reads as `0`      (always-allow), so no account is seizable until an issuer configures the slot.

SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY().details: Mirrors `MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY`: always enforced on the seize destination. An unset slot reads      as `0` (always-allow), so seize may send anywhere until an issuer configures the slot.

TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY().details: Bypassed for factory-originated calls during the creation (bootstrap) window; see      `IB20Factory.createB20`.

TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY().details: Bypassed for factory-originated calls during the creation (bootstrap) window; see      `IB20Factory.createB20`.

TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY().details: Bypassed for factory-originated calls during the creation (bootstrap) window; see      `IB20Factory.createB20`.

approve(address,uint256).details: Reverts with `InvalidApprover` when `msg.sender == address(0)`.Reverts with `InvalidSpender` when `spender == address(0)`.

params.account: Account whose balance is being queried.

burn(uint256).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(BURN)` when `BURN` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `BURN_ROLE`.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when the caller's balance is below `amount`.

burnBlocked(address,uint256).details: Gated by `BURN_BLOCKED_ROLE` and the `BURN` pause vector (not `SEIZE`). Its blocked check      reads `TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY`, distinct from `seizeWithMemo`'s `SEIZE_HOLDER_POLICY`.Reverts with `ContractPaused(BURN)` when `BURN` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `BURN_BLOCKED_ROLE`.Reverts with `AccountNotBlocked` when `from` is currently authorized under `TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY`.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when `from`'s balance is below `amount`.

params.from: Account whose blocked balance is being burned.

params.role: Role whose admin is being queried.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold the admin role for `role`,      or when the token has been transitioned to admin-less via `renounceLastAdmin` (admin-resurrection guard).

mint(address,uint256).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(MINT)` when `MINT` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `MINT_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when `to == address(0)`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when `to` is not authorized.Reverts with `SupplyCapExceeded` when `totalSupply + amount > supplyCap`.

params.owner: Account whose nonce is being queried.

pause(uint8[]).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `PAUSE_ROLE`.Reverts with `EmptyFeatureSet` when `features.length == 0`.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Reverts with `ExpiredSignature` when `block.timestamp > deadline`.Reverts with `InvalidSigner` when ECDSA recovery does not yield `owner`.Reverts with `InvalidSpender` when `spender == address(0)`.

params.deadline: Unix timestamp after which the signature is invalid.

policyId(bytes32).details: Reverts with `UnsupportedPolicyType` when `policyScope` is not recognized by this token.

renounceLastAdmin().details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when `msg.sender` does not hold `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.Reverts with `NotSoleAdmin` when other accounts also hold `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Reverts with `AccessControlBadConfirmation` when `callerConfirmation != msg.sender`.Reverts with `LastAdminCannotRenounce` when `role == DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and the caller is the last default admin.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold the admin role for `role`,      or when the token has been transitioned to admin-less via `renounceLastAdmin`.Reverts with `LastAdminCannotRenounce` when `role == DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and `account` is the last default admin.      Use `renounceLastAdmin` to clear the final admin.

seizeWithMemo(address,address,uint256,by.details: Admin operation: skips allowance and the transfer policies. The membership checks are that      `from` is blocked under `SEIZE_HOLDER_POLICY` and `to` is authorized under `SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY`.`to` is gated by `SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY`, which defaults to always-allow when unset, so an      unconfigured token may seize to any destination (a treasury need not be allowlisted).Reverts with `ContractPaused(SEIZE)` when `SEIZE` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `SEIZE_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when `to == address(0)` or `from == to`.Reverts with `InvalidSender` when `from == address(0)`.Reverts with `AccountNotSeizable` when `from` is currently authorized under `SEIZE_HOLDER_POLICY`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when `to` is not authorized under `SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY`.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when `from`'s balance is below `amount`.

params.from: Account whose balance is being seized.
params.to: Destination address for the seized balance.

setRoleAdmin(bytes32,bytes32).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold the current admin role for `role`,      or when the token has been transitioned to admin-less via `renounceLastAdmin`.

params.role: Role whose admin is being updated.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(TRANSFER)` when `TRANSFER` is paused.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when `to == address(0)`.Reverts with `InvalidSender` when `msg.sender == address(0)`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY, ...)` when `msg.sender` is not authorized.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when `to` is not authorized.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when `msg.sender`'s balance is below `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(TRANSFER)` when `TRANSFER` is paused.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when `to == address(0)`.Reverts with `InvalidSender` when `from == address(0)`.Reverts with `InsufficientAllowance` when the caller's allowance from `from` is below `amount`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY, ...)` when `msg.sender != from` and `msg.sender` is not authorized.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY, ...)` when `from` is not authorized.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when `to` is not authorized.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when `from`'s balance is below `amount`.

unpause(uint8[]).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `UNPAUSE_ROLE`.Reverts with `EmptyFeatureSet` when `features.length == 0`.

updateContractURI(string).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `METADATA_ROLE`.

updateName(string).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `METADATA_ROLE`.

updatePolicy(bytes32,uint64).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.Reverts with `UnsupportedPolicyType` when `policyScope` is not recognized by this token.Reverts with `PolicyNotFound` when `newPolicyId` is not a built-in sentinel and does not exist in the registry.

params.newPolicyId: Policy ID to assign to the slot.

updateSupplyCap(uint256).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidSupplyCap` when `newSupplyCap < totalSupply()` or `newSupplyCap > type(uint128).max`.

params.newSupplyCap: New supply cap. Must not exceed `type(uint128).max`.

updateSymbol(string).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `METADATA_ROLE`.

Paused(address,uint8[]).notice: Emitted by `pause`. `features` is the argument to the call (not the resulting paused state).

Transfer(address,address,uint256).notice: ERC-20 transfer event. Emitted on every successful transfer (including memo'd variants),         mint (`from = address(0)`), and burn (`to = address(0)`, including `burnBlocked`).

Emits         `Announcement` then `EndAnnouncement` with the same `id`. Pass an empty         `internalCalls` for a pure disclosure.

approve(address,uint256).notice: Sets `spender`'s allowance to `amount`. Not gated by any policy or by pause. Emits `Approval`.

Retained for back-compat;         prefer `seizeWithMemo` (to a treasury/self address) followed by `burn`.         Emits `Transfer(from, address(0), amount)` and `BurnedBlocked(caller, from, amount)`.

burnWithMemo(uint256,bytes32).notice: Same as `burn`, plus emits `Memo` immediately after the standard `Transfer` event.         A memo of `bytes32(0)` is permitted.

cancelUIMultiplierUpdate().notice: Cancels the single live pending update, restoring the no-pending state         (`effectiveAt` resets to 0).

contractURI().notice: Off-chain URI pointing at contract-level metadata for this token, per ERC-7572.

decimals().notice: Number of decimal places. Immutable per token variant.

mintWithMemo(address,uint256,bytes32).notice: Same as `mint`, plus emits `Memo` immediately after the standard `Transfer` event.         A memo of `bytes32(0)` is permitted.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Transfers `amount` from `from` to `to` using `msg.sender`'s allowance. Emits `Transfer`.

transferWithMemo(address,uint256,bytes32.notice: Same as `transfer`, plus emits `Memo` immediately after the standard `Transfer` event.         A memo of `bytes32(0)` is permitted.

updateExtraMetadata(string,string).notice: Sets, updates, or removes an extra-metadata entry. An empty `value` removes the         entry. Emits `ExtraMetadataUpdated`.

updateMultiplier(uint256).notice: DEPRECATED. userdoc.notice: A B-20 token variant for assets of all kinds. Extends `IB20` with announcements,         multiplier-based scaling, batched mint for bulk issuance, and extra-metadata         entries.

B20Created(address,uint8,string,string,u.details: `variantEventParams` carries variant-specific immutable identity data, ABI-encoded      and prefixed with a version byte. Empty for ASSET; for STABLECOIN,      `abi.encode(B20StablecoinEventParams)` with `currency`.`decimals` mirrors the value chosen at creation: configurable in      `[B20Constants.MIN_ASSET_DECIMALS, B20Constants.MAX_ASSET_DECIMALS]` for ASSET      (from `B20AssetCreateParams.decimals`); hardcoded to `6` for STABLECOIN.

createB20(uint8,bytes32,bytes,bytes[]).details: Reverts with `NonPayable` when ETH is attached to the call.Reverts with IActivationRegistry.FeatureNotActivated when the variant feature is not activated.Reverts with `InvalidVariant` when `variant` is outside the `B20Variant` range.Reverts with `UnsupportedVersion` when the leading `version` byte in `params` is unrecognized for `variant`.Reverts with `MissingRequiredField` when a required string field is empty (e.g. stablecoin `currency`).Reverts with `InvalidCurrency` when a stablecoin `currency` is non-empty but contains a non-`A`-`Z` byte.Reverts with `InvalidDecimals` when an asset `decimals` is outside `[B20Constants.MIN_ASSET_DECIMALS, B20Constants.MAX_ASSET_DECIMALS]`.Reverts with `TokenAlreadyExists` when a token already exists at the derived address.Reverts with `InitCallFailed` (or the bubbled inner reason) when any entry in `initCalls` reverts.Each `initCall` executes on the new token within the creation (bootstrap) window, during which      factory-originated calls bypass the token's role gates and its transfer-side policy gates      (`TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY`, `TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY`, `TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY`) — so admin-gated      setup (e.g. `grantRole`, `updatePolicy`, `updateSupplyCap`) and bootstrap transfers succeed without      the factory holding any role. The bypass is deliberately NOT total:      - `MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY` is ALWAYS enforced, including for factory-originated mints, so new supply is        never issued to a policy-denied recipient even at creation. An `initCalls` bundle that sets a        restrictive `MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY` and then mints to a non-authorized account reverts        `PolicyForbids(MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` (bubbled out of `createB20`).      - Pause is never bypassed. It defaults to nothing-paused at creation, so a start-paused        configuration must sequence its `pause(...)` call last among the `initCalls`.      - Token invariants (supply-cap math, balance accounting) are never bypassed.      The window closes when `createB20` returns; the factory retains no persisted access.

InitCallFailed(uint256).notice: One of the `initCalls` reverted. The factory bubbles the underlying revert reason         where the call returns one; this error wraps empty reverts.

InvalidCurrency(string).notice: The stablecoin `currency` was non-empty but contained a non-`A`-`Z` byte.

InvalidDecimals(uint8).notice: The asset `decimals` was outside the allowed inclusive range         `[B20Constants.MIN_ASSET_DECIMALS, B20Constants.MAX_ASSET_DECIMALS]`.

MissingRequiredField(string).notice: A required string argument was the empty string.

NonPayable().notice: ETH was attached to a call targeting a nonpayable factory selector.

TokenAlreadyExists(address).notice: A token already exists at the deterministic address derived from         `(variant, msg.sender, salt)`. Caller must use a different salt.

UnsupportedVersion(uint8,uint8).notice: The leading `version` byte in `params` does not match any known encoding for the requested variant.

B20Created(address,uint8,string,string,u.notice: Emitted once per `createB20` invocation, after the token's identity is sealed         and before any `initCalls` are dispatched.

createB20(uint8,bytes32,bytes,bytes[]).notice: Creates a B-20 token of the given `variant` at the deterministic address derived         from `(variant, msg.sender, salt)`, then dispatches each entry in `initCalls` on         the new token. Emits `B20Created`.

getB20Address(uint8,address,bytes32).notice: Returns the deterministic address `createB20` would assign for `(variant, sender, salt)`. Never reverts.

isB20(address).notice: Returns whether `token` was created by this factory, recovered from the address prefix. Never reverts.

isB20Initialized(address).notice: Returns whether `createB20` has run to completion at `token`. Flips exactly once,         the moment the creating `createB20` call returns. Never reverts.

userdoc.notice: Singleton factory precompile for creating B-20 tokens of any variant. A single         entry point `createB20` dispatches on a `B20Variant` discriminator; variant-specific         arguments are ABI-encoded into `params` with a leading `version` byte.
